hostingNotes: 100–10,000 MAU assumes Replit Autoscale remains the primary web/API runtime.
100,000 MAU assumes a Reserved VM or equivalent always-on worker capacity is added alongside Autoscale.

1,000,000 MAU is a planning placeholder for multiple API workers, queue consumers, read replicas, and dedicated observability; it is not a claim that one Replit Autoscale instance can sustain that load.

measuredFacts.fact: The project is configured for a Replit Autoscale deployment target.
The application uses PostgreSQL through Drizzle ORM.
The application uses Replit Object Storage for files.
Transactional email is sent through Resend.
AI features use the Replit OpenAI integration proxy.
measuredFacts.source: replit.md and AI integration environment variables

measuredFacts.fact: Vacancy ingestion is split across board, company-site, probe, liveness, contact, Reed, and additional-board jobs.
The recent production audit found company-site traffic materially above its intended hourly cadence and a high temporary-failure rate.
